subject.title: fix(secrets): surface degradation in logs and doctor

question: Should cold-start isolation now include web-tool providers and webhook routes, or remain limited to the owner classes established by the merged foundation until each additional boundary is approved separately?
rationale: This branch deliberately changes startup availability semantics for new owner classes; code review can verify implementation mechanics but cannot determine the intended product and security boundary.

options.title: Approve the expanded owner boundary
options.body: Keep web-tool and webhook-route isolation, but land only after the credential-file diagnostic repair and current-head behavior proof.

options.title: Keep the original bounded scope
options.body: Limit this PR to degradation reporting and reload attribution for the already-approved owner classes, leaving new owner isolation to narrower follow-ups.

recommendation.title: Approve the expanded owner boundary
recommendation.body: Keep web-tool and webhook-route isolation, but land only after the credential-file diagnostic repair and current-head behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged foundation authored by snowzlmbot defined the original ownership-isolation scope and its deferred follow-up boundary.
